name: codegraph
description: Injects the official CodeGraph prompt when a .codegraph directory exists and exposes 21 CLI commands as slash commands. Pure Python stdlib.

description_i18n.en: Injects the official CodeGraph prompt when a .codegraph directory exists and exposes 21 CLI commands as slash commands. Pure Python stdlib.

defaultPromptZhCn: 用 /codegraph-init 索引此仓库，我就能通过 CodeGraph 回答代码问题
找出我刚改的那个函数的所有调用方
看看如果改 <symbol> 会影响哪些代码
跑一下 /codegraph-status，看索引是否过期
